10 استحجر : see 8. ＝
-A2- Also It (clay) became stone: (TA:) or became hard; as when it is made into baked bricks: (Mgh:) or became hard like stone: (A, Msb;) as also ↓ تحجّر . (A.) ―
-b2- (assumed tropical:) He became emboldened or encouraged, or he emboldened or encouraged himself, (K TA,) عَلَيْهِ against him. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
